snippet.title: Twin growth discordance (Twins world inside the womb)
snippet.description:
Why do some identical twins grow differently inside the womb?
In this video, we explore the fascinating world of Monochorionic-Diamniotic (Mo-Di) twins — twins who share the same placenta but have separate amniotic sacs. Learn how they form, how their shared blood vessels connect, and why sometimes one twin receives more nutrients and blood supply than the other — a condition known as Twin-to-Twin Transfusion Syndrome (TTTS).

Through clear visuals and simple explanations, you’ll understand:
🌿 How Mo-Di twins develop from a single fertilized egg
🩸 How the shared placenta can lead to unequal blood flow
⚖️ Why one twin may grow larger while the other struggles
💓 How doctors monitor and manage Mo-Di twin pregnancies

This is a must-watch for anyone curious about twin biology, fetal development, and the amazing science of life before birth!

But when her brother lifted the seat, he came face to face with a black bear.

The bear had crawled in through a gap beneath the outhouse and was living under the toilet. He slammed the lid shut, and they ran to safety, waiting for the bear to leave on its own.

snippet.title: The City That Danced Itself to Death 😳
snippet.description:
In 1518, a woman stepped into the streets and began dancing uncontrollably. Days later, dozens joined her. Then hundreds.

The more they danced, the worse it became. Authorities even hired musicians, believing more dancing would cure the problem. Instead, the frenzy intensified.

For weeks, people danced without rest, collapsing from exhaustion and, according to historical accounts, some even died.

More than 500 years later, the mysterious "Dancing Plague" remains one of history's strangest unsolved events.
